name: Licensing Agreement
description: Risk checklist for IP licensing and royalty agreements.

categories.name: License grant
categories.description: Flag overly broad license grants, missing territory or field-of-use limits, or exclusive licenses with no performance obligations.

categories.name: Royalties and payment
categories.description: Flag vague royalty bases, missing audit rights, or payment terms that delay reporting beyond a reasonable period.

categories.name: IP ownership and improvements
categories.description: Flag assignment of improvements to the other party, missing moral rights language, or unclear ownership of derivative works.

categories.name: Term and termination
categories.description: Flag perpetual licenses without a termination path, short cure periods, or survival of restrictions after termination.

categories.name: Warranties and infringement
categories.description: Flag missing infringement indemnification, overbroad warranties, or no process for third-party IP claims.
